name: Electric Vehicle Laboratory 01
description: Basic rectifier systems; power supply regulators; magnetic design; basic non-isolated converters; power factor correction circuits; battery module design and development – cell sorting, cell welding process; battery management system – basic cell balancing; manufacturing of battery cells; operation of two level inverters; characterization of permanent magnet synchronous machine; basic drive experiments; characterization and experiments on hybrid vehicle.
